quotes.text: We had a Christmas tree up and Christmas lights. The lights were turned down low. It was wonderful.

It's honestly still surreal to me whenever I hear it on the radio. It's hard to believe. Of all the songs, I could have never thought that I would have a Christmas standard. But I do, and I'm grateful.

When it comes to my label, Decca, I don't have the words. They are the best. And the reason they are the best is that, to this day they don't forget who helped build the label. I'm a part of that, and I'm proud to be a part of that.

One of the reasons I got 'Rockin'' was that Johnny said, "I want her to sing it. And if she won't do it, send it back to me."

I used to talk to Johnny just about every day. He was precious. He'd get on the phone and here was his opening line from when I was 13 on was, 'Hi Brenda, it's Johnny! Just wanted to let you know there's not a lot of us older folks left!' I'm like, How old does he think I am?

They were the best of the best, and were like all my big brothers. With those guys, nothing was ever written. Whatever they played came from their heart, and that's what you hear in those records. We kept in touch and saw each other over the years, but most of them are not here with us anymore.
Back then that was the way you did it. I recorded that way until I retired. I never wanted to come in and overdub afterwards. I wanted everybody there.
